item.title: West Virginia DOT says asphalt plants opening earlier in 2026
item.description: The recent warm weather means some asphalt plants in West Virginia will be able to open early, according to the West Virginia Department of Transportation.

item.title: UHC doctor urges colorectal cancer screenings for anyone over 45
item.description: The American Cancer Society predicts that 55,000 people or more will pass away from colorectal cancer this year, and doctors at United Hospital Center (UHC) in Bridgeport are raising awareness for those at risk.

item.title: Fairmont State University hosts VEX Robotics State Championship
item.description: Students from all over West Virginia have made their way to the Falcon Center at Fairmont State University this week to showcase their custom-built robots.

item.title: West Virginia father pleads guilty to sexual assault charges involving daughter
item.description: A West Virginia man has pleaded guilty to multiple sexual assault charges involving a juvenile.

item.title: Coal industry provides $21 billion, 36,000 jobs to West Virginia economy: Study says
item.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. (WTRF) — A new study reports that coal mining and coal-fired power generation continue to play a major role in West Virginia’s economy. item.title: Harrison, Shaw lead Mountaineers to Big 12 tournament championship over top-seeded TCU
item.description: For the first time since 2017, the West Virginia Mountaineers are Big 12 tournament champions. item.title: Morgantown man charged after victim found bleeding from eye socket
item.description: A Morgantown man has been arrested and is facing charges after allegedly assaulting a victim in a downtown nightclub.

item.title: Bridgeport resident concerned about future of housing amid property sale
item.description: Back in December, 12 News reported that the city of Bridgeport acquired property downtown that includes an occupied trailer park. However, as of Monday, the sale has not been completed, leaving some trailer park residents wondering what's next.

item.title: Details released in death of Elkins High School student
item.description: The West Virginia State Police has released more information regarding the death of an Elkins High School student over the weekend.

item.title: 3 charged in Marion County after victim hit with machete during burglary
item.description: Three people are facing charges in Marion County after a victim was hit in the head with a machete during an alleged burglary.
